'''Kredo Daar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] serving with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Daar had an altercation with an [[SE4 servant droid]] who insisted that the [[Fork/Legends|fork]] he was using to eat his meat with&mdash;the first [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that Daar had had in a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] that had not come from a [[plasti-pak]]&mdash;was intended to be used with salad.
